name: Speaker + cabinet as a circuit (SPICE gate)
description: A Marshall 1960AX-style 4x12: four Celestion G12M-25 (16 ohm) wired 2s2p as one nonlinear equivalent driver, voltage-driven at its terminals, with the closed-box air spring and the acoustic path fitted to Jester's CC0 Emerald IR (lib:cab-1960ax-g12m25-sm57). 'mic' is the cab output: terminal volts convolved with the IR, times 0.1.

sources.title: Jester's Emerald Pack 1.0, Jester Dyne Productions (Bastian Karschewski), CC0 1.0 (cab IR the acoustic path is fitted to)
